class.name: Box3DRagdollProfile
class.description: [Box3DRagdollProfile] stores per-bone capsule and joint settings for [Box3DRagdoll]. R1 uses dictionary entries in [member bones]; the profile generator and editor tooling are planned for a later milestone.

members.member: Array of dictionaries. Each entry uses [code]bone[/code] ([StringName]), [code]enabled[/code], [code]offset[/code] ([Transform3D]), [code]radius[/code], [code]height[/code], [code]density_scale[/code], [code]joint_type[/code], [code]swing_limit[/code], [code]twist_lower[/code], [code]twist_upper[/code], [code]joint_friction_scale[/code], and [code]blend[/code].
Collision layer assigned to generated ragdoll bodies.
Collision mask assigned to generated ragdoll bodies.
Array of two-name arrays. Each pair creates a native Box3D filter joint that disables collision between those two bone bodies.
Max zero-velocity motor torque used as joint friction.
Spherical joint spring frequency in hertz.
